name: Soco
overview: Soco is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified as the son of Mered and his Jewish wife. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, providing a link within the lineage of Judah. No additional personal details or notable deeds are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Soco appears as a proper name in Scripture without any specified meaning or divine origin. It is simply a personal name recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:18.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Soco as the son of Mered and his Jewish wife, and he is also inferred to be the father of Heber. Beyond these relationships, no further family details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Soco's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, emphasizing the continuity of God's covenant people through family lines. His mention helps trace the lineage and heritage important for understanding the tribal structure and God's providential care for His people. Although not prominent in narrative events, Soco contributes to the biblical record of God's faithfulness across generations.
